## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5); Tech and Financials weak while Utilities, Communication and Materials show relative strength — confirms rotation.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND; TTWO (1W: +5.89% | 1M: -13.04%) RECOVERY. Utilities strong: CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND; SO (news) supportive. Materials showing strength: FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND; NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +3.11%) CORRECTION. Financials weak: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND; GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND; JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND; AMZN (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -13.58%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND, CEG (1W: +11.88% | 1M: +14.56%) ABOVE TREND, PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, NEM (1W: +6.44% | 1M: -1.48%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors) — favors selective exposure to pockets of strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AXP (1W: -10.77% | 1M: -13.47%) BELOW TREND, PNC (1W: -8.85% | 1M: -4.08%) BELOW TREND, MET (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -4.82%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -8.17% | 1M: -7.02%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Financials (3/5 of bottom5) and big-cap Tech — risk to cyclically sensitive books.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: NFLX (1W: +22.33%), CEG (1W: +11.88%), PYPL (1W: +10.95%) — watch PYPL (1W up | 1M down) and INTU (1W up | 1M down) as RECOVERY setups. Major divergence across large names (AAPL, PYPL, INTU, CRM): MAJOR Divergence — tactical opportunities, not core position changes until confirmed.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed-to-weak; dominant names are below trend with short-term bounces in select software. Keys: MSFT (1W: -1.13% | 1M: -18.27%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY, CRM (1W: +5.20% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY. Sector breadth: ~5/24 positive — internal rotation within tech.

8. Financials Outlook?
Broad weakness across banks and cap markets names with clustering in the losers. Keys: BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -6.80% | 1M: -8.25%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -0.16%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: ~3/20 positive — Financials not leading this rotation.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive bid intact with several large caps ABOVE TREND and supportive news flows. Keys: JNJ (1W: +2.99% | 1M: +9.67%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +3.75% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: ~12/17 positive — defensive pocket within rotation.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure to pockets of cyclicals and defensives showing confirmed ABOVE TREND (XOM, CVX, FCX, JNJ, MDLZ) and reduce exposure to broad Tech and large-cap Financials showing BELOW TREND. Style: Value/Cyclical tilt within a ROTATION regime; monitor RECOVERY names (PYPL, INTU, CRM) for confirmation rather than scaling core allocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NFLX (1W: +22.33% | 1M: +13.71%) ABOVE TREND — follow-through after catalyst; LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND on positive news; FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND on operational news. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -6.65% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND; BAC (1W: -6.09% | 1M: -3.82%) BELOW TREND — downside momentum to monitor.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Utilities (Breadth: ~9/10 positive) and Materials (Breadth: ~8/11 positive) as rotation beneficiaries. BEARISH: Technology (Breadth: ~5/24 positive) and Financials (Breadth: ~3/20 positive) remain under pressure.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NFLX watch for consolidation above recent gap (ABOVE TREND continuation). NVDA watch for breakdown continuation below short-term support (BELOW TREND). LLY hold above weekly pivot for confirmation (ABOVE TREND continuation).

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
LLY (+65): Eli Lilly oral GLP‑1 win — LLY (1W: +4.21% | 1M: +2.92%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. FCX (+65): Grasberg rights — FCX (1W: +5.81% | 1M: +6.99%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed. EOG (+85) and EA (+90) headlines bullish but cross-check price/positioning before adding exposure.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
TSLA (-65): Safety concerns on FSD — TSLA (1W: -2.26% | 1M: -6.71%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. PYPL (-60): Legal and CEO change headlines — PYPL (1W: +10.95% | 1M: -14.55%) RECOVERY — sentiment diverging from price (distribution risk). INTU (-50): price-target cut — INTU (1W: +7.48% | 1M: -24.07%) RECOVERY — monitor for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION, Value/Cyclical style; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive and leadership is Broad (5 sectors). Stocks showing relative strength include NFLX ABOVE TREND, CEG ABOVE TREND, FCX ABOVE TREND. Key risk: MAJOR Divergence (multiple large caps with 1W ≠ 1M and several bearish news items) — tactical setups, not broad regime confirmation.
